tasks.title: Email login + link (magic code) in server.py, pass unit+contract layers
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Refactor + extend server.py (stdlib only) so BOTH gate layers pass: `python test_unit.py` and `python test_app.py`. Read both test files FIRST — they are the executable specification.

Unit layer requires server.py to expose these pure functions (test_unit.py imports the module, so server.py MUST be importable without starting the server — wrap startup in `def main()` + `if __name__ == "__main__": main()`): make_token() (urlsafe, >=20 chars), make_code() (6-digit str), valid_email(s) (must contain @ with dot in domain, no spaces; reject 'a@b', 'a@b.c.'), deadline_for(created_at) (=+100*86400), days_left(decide_at, now) (int, floored at 0), check_code(stored_code, expires_at, attempts, code, now) -> (ok: bool, reason: str) — expired fails, wrong code fails, attempts>=5 locks even for the right code, and load_store(path)/save_store(path, store) (atomic: tmp file + os.replace, no leftovers; load missing file -> {}; load old schema without email/codes keys must work).

Contract layer adds HTTP routes (read tests 08-13 in test_app.py): POST /l/<tok>/link {email} -> validate via valid_email, store pending code (6-digit, expires now+900, attempts 0) in the list's entry, send mail containing the code to the address, redirect; POST /l/<tok>/verify {code} -> check_code, on success set list['email']=email and clear pending code, redirect; 5 failed attempts invalidate the code.
Login: POST /login {email} -> identical response shape whether or not the email is linked (no enumeration — only actually send a code when the address is linked to at least one list); POST /login/verify {email, code} -> session-less: set a short-lived signed token cookie? NO COOKIES — instead redirect to /lists?e=<email>&k=<code-hash> is FORBIDDEN too; the accepted simple pattern: /login/verify renders the lists page inline (200) for a correct code, and GET /lists shows lists for ?e=<email>&t=<token> where <token> is the just-used login code stored server-side as 'login session' with 15min TTL. Tests only require: after correct /login/verify, GET /lists contains /l/<tok> for linked lists; unknown email at /login/verify -> /lists shows no /l/ URLs. Keep it as simple as these tests demand.

SMTP via env, ONE function send_mail(to, subject, body) reused everywhere: YAGNI_SMTP_MODE=none -> /link and /login return a clean error page with status >= 400 (no crash, no fake success); mode=file -> append a plain RFC822-ish mail (To:, Subject:, body) to YAGNI_SMTP_FILE; mode=smtp -> smtplib.SMTP(YAGNI_SMTP_HOST, YAGNI_SMTP_PORT) sendmail from YAGNI_SMTP_FROM.

Back-compat: existing data/lists.json without email/codes keys loads unchanged; save stays atomic. All existing behavior (tests 01-07) must keep passing. Commit server.py on the current branch.

tasks.title: notify.py — decision-due mailer, pass notify contract
tasks.acceptance_prose: Write notify.py (stdlib only, reuses helpers from server.py via `import server`) so `python test_notify.py` passes AND the contract layer stays green (`python test_app.py`). Read test_notify.py first — it is the executable spec. CLI: `python notify.py --data DIR --smtp-file FILE --now TS` (also accept --smtp-host/--smtp-port/--from for production; file mode is what the tests use). Behavior: load store, for every list with an email, for every item with status 'waiting', decide_at <= now and not item.get('notified'): send ONE mail (To: list email, Subject mentions the item name and that the 100 days are up, body asks to buy or drop) and set item['notified']=true; save atomically; exit 0. Lists without an email and legacy schemas (no email key) are skipped without crashing. Reruns must not duplicate (the notified flag governs). Use server.send_mail so the SMTP abstraction stays in one place; --now overrides time.time() for deterministic tests. Commit notify.py (and any server.py import-fix needed) on the current branch.

tasks.title: E2E smoke: full email journey
tasks.acceptance_prose: Extend smoke.py (keep all existing checks passing — it must still print SMOKE PASS at the end) with the full email journey, stdlib only: start server.py with YAGNI_SMTP_MODE=file, then (1) create list, add item; (2) link an email via /l/<tok>/link, read the 6-digit code from the smtp file, verify via /l/<tok>/verify, assert the page shows the email; (3) login from the landing page with the same email, read the new code, POST /login/verify, GET /lists and assert it contains /l/<tok>; (4) craft the store's item decide_at in the past, run notify.py as a subprocess with the same data dir + smtp file + now, assert exactly one due mail mentioning the item, run again and assert no duplicate; (5) still assert: no Set-Cookie anywhere, restart persistence for both lists and the linked email. Print SMOKE PASS on success, exit nonzero with a clear message on failure. Commit smoke.py on the current branch.
